eligibility_text: Any Indian resident aged 18 to 70 with a savings bank account, Aadhaar-linked, who consents to annual auto-debit of the premium.
benefits: Rs 2 lakh on accidental death or total disability; Rs 1 lakh on partial permanent disability. Annual premium Rs 20, auto-debited each June.
source_note: Verified Sep 2026 — premium raised from Rs 12 to Rs 20 in June 2022, current since.
